Here are the photos for Upside Living: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-upside-living-13851875.html

It's AED 5,500/month, the lowest studio we have in Business Bay right now. For December, rates get reviewed every 3 months, so your August 29 rate would lock in through late November. Want to go ahead with the 29th as your move-in?
